name: Thompson / Grand River Valley KOA Holiday
evidence: KOA site map (rev 04/2025) + OSIP leaf-off 0.2 m/px at 41.6963,-81.0365: 'fishing pond' ~1.4 ha ringed by the loop road; bank side holds cabins and glamping; nearest nightly RV pads (LS1-4) ~25-30 m across that road. No RV pad on the bank, so not `pond`; a pond is not a lake, so not lakeview.

name: Town & Country Camp Resort
evidence: OSIP 0.24 m/px at 40.9605,-82.0688: north pond ~110x70 m has no pads on it, nearest rows across the park road or ~50 m behind a loop road; small south pond flanked by settled units; east ponds ~90 m from transient pull-through block. Operator 'fishing ponds' is a lead only. Engine map not read.

name: Kiser Lake State Park
evidence: ReserveOhio facility 485 per-site coords plotted on OSIP + Esri 0.2 m/px at 40.1819,-83.9500: non-electric back-in sites 71, 73, 74, 77, 79, west of Kiser Lake Rd, spurs end ~10-15 m from the water across open unused grass, no road or treeline between; sizes 31-95 ft, bookable online. Electric sites across the road do not earn it.

name: Burr Oak State Park
evidence: ReserveOhio facility 400 + OSIP/Esri 0.29 m/px at 39.5372,-82.0310: end-loop sites 16-29 ~35-60 m from the shore through a continuous wooded bank, solid summer canopy, no sightline; west row 43-60 85+ m wooded. Tent 65-81 and 16-ft Dock Area sites do not count. Site plots run ~100 m off, so judged by the roads.

name: Pleasant Hill Lake Park
evidence: MWCD brochure map 2021 + OSIP/Esri 0.2 m/px at 40.6463,-82.3358 and 40.6470,-82.3325: only shore row is Horse Camp 500-537, which does not count; Areas A-G inland behind park road/trail and tree band, nearest pads ~50-65 m; open lawn gives east-end rows a diagonal view. Area E closed until 2027. MWCD 'waterfront' tags behind captcha, unread.

name: Clendening Lake Marina & Campground
evidence: MWCD site map cle_camping.pdf + OSIP 0.16 m/px and Esri 0.25 m/px at 40.2390,-81.2218: pads 93-99 on a spit, ~14 m long, ~10-15 m of open grass to the rip-rap bank, spur lane behind them. Would earn lakefront if sold nightly, but reserve.mwcd.org is behind a captcha and Piedmont's shore row (1240) was not; empty in April is only a hint. Lakeview stands.

name: Lake Snowden Campground (Hocking College)
evidence: Operator Campground_Map.png + OSIP/Esri 0.27-0.36 m/px at 39.2455,-82.1890 and 39.2432,-82.1900: Oak Camp tracks ~45 m from the lake through continuous wooded bank, solid summer canopy, so 'some lakefront sites' unproven; Grassy Camp 42-47 on open grass at the cove head, own lane and shrub fringe before the water = view. Site placement read from an overview map.

name: New London Reservoir Park & Campground
evidence: City site map (Resevoir and Campground Map.jpeg) + Esri 0.22 m/px at 41.0708,-82.4262: W&E spurs 118A-119B run south off the loop road toward the shore, spur ends ~10-15 m from the beach edge, spurs ~15 m long, thin scattered trees, no road between. Loop 120-131 is behind road and cabins; lots 1-103 are 150-400 m back; T111-114 primitive tent sites do not count.
